content: If d irect data provision is used with a FIFO : When PduR_<SrcLo /SrcLoTp >RxIndication is called and the FIFO queue is empty and no confirmation is outstanding for the same PDU, <DstLo /DstLoTp >_Transmit shall be called directly. The FIFO stays empty.

If direct data provision is used with a FIFO: When PduR_<SrcLo/SrcLoTp>RxIndication is called and the FIFO queue is empty and no confirmation is outstanding for the same PDU, <DstLo/DstLoTp>_Trans- mit shall be called directly. The FIFO stays empty.

If direct data provision is used with a FIFO: when PduR_<SrcLo>RxIndication is called and the FIFO queue is empty and no confir- mation is outstanding for the same PDU, <DstLo>_Transmit shall be called directly. The FIFO stays empty.
